kf51_evo.name: KF51 Panther EVO (Eurosatory 2024)
kf51_evo.authority: Proposed by the release-267 IFV lane (item/ifv-kf51-modern-267) under Main's rulings of 2026-10-28 ("where a rebuild's registered oracle shows a different (later) variant, unregister it") and 2026-10-29 (the unregistered rebuilds qualify the geometry stage by a per-id photographic packet plus a shaded blind photo-critic PASS); Main accepts or vetoes it at the lane's READY. kf51_evo is rebuilt from the Eurosatory 2024 photographs as the Panther EVO upgrade, the EVO turret on a Leopard 2A4 hull with the Rh-130 shown on the stand (profiles/kf51Evo.ts); its old oracle kf51_grip420.glb shows the 2022 KF51 Panther demonstrator (fleet id kf51_panther) and is unregistered. Its blind A/B against these photographs (Opus and Sonnet critics) chose the rebuild. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified: no model of the EVO exists.
kf51_evo.envelopeBasis: As built (Box3 at both qualities, the photo check's rule). Width over the Leopard 2A4 flank's reactive panels (x +-1.807; the published Leopard 2A4 is 3.70-3.75 m over its skirts). Length from the hull's stern (z -3.868) to the Rh-130's muzzle with the gun forward (z 7.005). Tallest is the tip of the left bustle whip antenna, as built rather than published; the turret's sights stand 3.34 m tall.
